[1/2] Plan: extract 8 residual eligible working-memory reviews (D7 gap) into the evidence table with verified PMIDs/DOIs

impact_assessment.why: The review logs 973 rule-eligible reviews as not extracted (deviation D7); working-memory transfer/durability is a core Noesis evidence cell with documented gaps.
impact_assessment.benefits: Closes part of D7, adds 8 verifiable effect-bearing records, strengthens near-vs-far transfer and durability claims, keeps counts traceable.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: evidence-table schema and snapshot counts; dependency: PubMed metadata only; concurrency: none; state: references and prose counts must move with the table
impact_assessment.mitigation: Fetch each abstract from NCBI eutils, use only reported estimates, update references/prose/tests in the same change, run review check and the full suite.

checkpoints.description: [1/2] Plan: add an experimental conjunction visual-search focus test grounded in task-specific training literature

impact_assessment.why: The practice menu needs another claim-bounded mechanic; conjunction visual-search training has task-specific evidence (PMIDs 35838486, 36922549, 30859709) and can be implemented as a static, non-flashing grid.
impact_assessment.benefits: New game with literature-grounded brief, set-size cost metric, and explicit near-transfer-only claim; no new evidence-table record needed.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: new MechanicId in engine/UI/tests; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: snapshots and counts must move with the new id
impact_assessment.mitigation: Copy the Change Detection integration pattern, add failing-first engine and UI tests, run all suites and gates, review the running UI.

checkpoints.description: [1/2] Plan: extract Li 2024 adherence/engagement meta-analysis and ground a literature note in the app's adherence card

impact_assessment.why: The app logs session completion but gives no evidence context; Li 2024 (55 RCTs, n=4,455) reports significant training effects above 60% engagement/persistence or 80% adherence.
impact_assessment.benefits: Turns the adherence card into an evidence-linked, honestly framed interpretation instead of a bare percentage.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: evidence record + UI note + test; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: counts and references must move together
impact_assessment.mitigation: Add one primary record with reported estimates, update counts and references, add the note with an explicit not-a-target caveat, run all suites and review the UI.

checkpoints.description: [1/2] Plan: extract Kelly 2014 and Chandler 2016 everyday-function reviews and ground the Results claim-boundary note

impact_assessment.why: The Results screen lists what a block does not mean but cites no source; two residual eligible reviews directly address everyday-function transfer in healthy older adults and MCI.
impact_assessment.benefits: Adds pooled near-transfer evidence and explicit everyday-function uncertainty with a verifiable PubMed link in the result view.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: two evidence records + results note + test; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: counts and references must move together
impact_assessment.mitigation: Verify both records via PubMed efetch, update counts/references/prose, add one linked note with a test, run all suites and review the UI.
